$comment: Provenance: bundled SPICE model library index for circsim, MIT. Every model file referenced here carries its own 'Provenance:' header and was written in-house from datasheet parameters (no vendor model text). PinMap node positions are 1-based and refer to the device's terminal order: diode/LED = 'anode cathode' (1=anode, 2=cathode); BJT = 'collector base emitter' (1=C, 2=B, 3=E); VDMOS = 'drain gate source' (1=D, 2=G, 3=S). Pad numbers come from the KiCad footprint. Diode footprints follow the KiCad convention pad-1 = cathode.

entries.$comment: SOP-8 power NMOS: pads 1-3=S, 4=G, 5-8=D. entries.$comment: Quad open-collector comparator — same behavioral cell as comparator-lm393 (subckt order inp inn out vcc vee). entries.$comment: SIMPLIFIED NORMAL-mode stub (subckt terminals vdd vss chg dsg): both external-FET gate drivers held at v(vdd) — no protection trips, no cell balancing, no AVDD/VTB (see power-ic.lib). TSSOP-24 datasheet pins: 1=VDD, 9=VSS, 13=CHG, 12=DSG (board-verified: pad1=PACK+, pad9=BATT-, pad13=CHG_DRV, pad12=DSG_DRV). Unmapped pads (VCx, SRP/SRN, TS, …) are left unconnected by design. entries.$comment: SIMPLIFIED idle/off stub V1 (subckt terminals vin intvcc tg1 bg1 tg2 bg2 gnd): behavioral 5V INTVCC LDO + 100k pulldowns holding all four external gate pins low — no switching, no charging (bench a CC/CV source on the output rail instead; see power-ic.lib). normalizeMpn does NOT strip ADI's #TRPBF ordering suffix, so the full board value is listed as an alias. Pad numbers are the JLC QFN-38 footprint's, verified from the routed board nets (pad7=VIN_CHG, pad10=INTVCC, pad1=TG1, pad37=BG1, pad31=TG2, pad33=BG2, pad3=GND) — they differ from the ADI datasheet pin numbering. One representative pad per rail (vin also on 36; intvcc also on 25/34). MPN/value matching only.
entries.provenance: Behavioral idle/off stub written for circsim from the ADI LTC4020 datasheet (INTVCC=5V LDO from VIN, gate-driver pins; QFN-38), MIT.

entries.$comment: SIMPLIFIED DC-AVERAGED constant-current sink (subckt terminals vin set sw ctrl gnd): smooth tanh servo holds v(vin,set) at the 100mV mean sense threshold so Iled~=100mV/Rs; CTRL dimming is a linear v/2.5 approximation with a smooth <0.2V off gate; no switching ripple (see power-ic.lib). MSOP-8EP pins: 8=VIN, 1=SET(ISET), 5=SW, 4=CTRL, 2=GND (one representative pad — SW also on 6, GND also on 3/EP). MPN/value matching only — before this entry, U + MSOP-8 fallback matched four nonsense opamp/comparator/timer entries on a real board (live false ambiguity).

entries.$comment: CD4000-series hex inverting Schmitt trigger, pin-compatible with the 74HC14. FIXED-SWING CAVEAT: outputs are modeled at the logic4000.json family constant of 12 V regardless of the actual rail (dac_bridge out_high is per-family; real part runs 3-18 V) — same accepted limitation as the 74HC family's 5 V. Schmitt threshold band 4.8/7.2 V (40%/60% of 12 V) via adc_bridge — in-band input yields an undefined mid-rail output (measured 6 V), not held state. MPN/value matching only — a U + 14-pin fallback would collide with the nine 74HC fallback rules (the LM339/CD4011 lesson).
entries.provenance: XSPICE behavioral CD40106 hex inverting Schmitt trigger written for circsim from datasheet pinout; hysteresis via adc_bridge in_low/in_high band at the fixed 12 V family rail, MIT.

entries.$comment: CD4000-series quad 2-input NAND. CRITICAL: the CD4011 pinout is NOT the 74HC00 pinout — outputs are on pins 3, 4, 10, 11 (74HC00 has 3, 6, 8, 11). FIXED-SWING CAVEAT: outputs are modeled at the logic4000.json family constant of 12 V regardless of the actual rail (dac_bridge out_high is per-family; real part runs 3-18 V). MPN/value matching only — a U + 14-pin fallback misresolved this exact part as an LM393 comparator on a real board before mpn gating.
entries.provenance: XSPICE behavioral CD4011 quad NAND written for circsim from datasheet pinout + typical tpd (d_nand) at the fixed 12 V family rail, MIT.
